What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 7.0 against the 7.7 rung (top rung 8.0). Art median 6.5, so the craft floor stood down at the cap.
  • Frame 6 changed after the panel. Its dek was reworded to clear a numeral trace failure, then its rotor and grid line were moved to clear the longer dek. The pixel critic passed it on re-review, but the panel never scored it, so the score row reads STALE.
  • tx-2026-0186 (FAA, Zipline) was not verified today. www.faa.gov answered 403 to both of the routine's readers, so a measured boundary was recorded instead and the item was last verified October 23rd.
  • Frames 3 and 5 pass numeral_trace on their drawing unit only by a substring coincidence. Queued, not exploited.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The load went to the wind. An AI data center plan beside Briscoe Wind, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Briscoe Wind's substation sits directly across from 397 acres.

Soluna announced on October 21st a deal to form a joint company with Applied Digital. It would develop a 50 MW AI data center near Silverton in Briscoe County.

That 50 MW is Phase 1 of Dorothy 3. Soluna expects Phase 1 to draw from Briscoe Wind and the grid. It describes Dorothy 3 as up to 300 MW.

Soluna bought the 397 acres in August. It says the substation positions Dorothy 3 for behind the meter access. It puts Briscoe Wind at 150 MW. Soluna's chief executive says Soluna was built "to bring load to the generation".

Closing depends in part on approval of a tax abatement in Briscoe County. Soluna expects to close by year end. The county posts its Tax Abatement Guidelines and Criteria beside its Commissioners Court agendas. Which public body decides the abatement, and when?

#BriscoeCounty #SilvertonTX #AppliedDigital

The machine changed itself

  • Two instincts added, count-the-drawn-figure-after-every-camera-move and grain-in-albedo-under-a-low-key. Two confirmed.
    A round 2 camera change dropped one of frame 6's five stakes and shipped a hard fail into round 3. Height noise on the county relief read as camouflage.
  • Nine machine defects newly queued in MACHINE_QUEUE.md and six raised to repeat 1. The weekly pass is not due.
    A run fixes only what broke in it. The queue feeds the weekly pass, which counts recurring themes by runs.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

THE RECORD Re-verify (commit 8db0290b): all 204 items were due on the two day leash. 176 were confirmed and 28 carry dated unconfirmed lines. Docket 59315 and 59029 filing counts, the PUCT meeting feed and the TAHC screwworm counts moved. Taylor's campus page now carries tx-2026-0203's annexation terms. Admitted tx-2026-0233 (commit 14493393): Soluna and Applied Digital's definitive agreement for a planned 50 MW AI data center at Dorothy 3 beside the Briscoe Wind Farm near Silverton. Closing waits in part on a Briscoe County tax abatement. Movement went on tx-2026-0087, tx-2026-0048 and tx-2026-0182. Held: four county findings with no verbatim proof (no agenda item naming either company on the October 13th and 16th Commissioners Court pages, two county hosts that didn't resolve). CI REPAIR BEFORE THE MERGE The first CI run went red on the record, not the deck. tx-2026-0186 (FAA, Zipline Texas metros draft) is live at pending and was last verified October 23rd. www.faa.gov answered 403 to the project's agent and to WebFetch. Earlier runs read it with a browser agent string. This run's classifier refused that as bot check circumvention, so it was not retried. The item now carries a measured blocks_every_client boundary dated today. It stays unverified and the next run re-measures it. THE DECK Carousel no. 62 shipped at the round cap at 7.0 against the 7.7 rung, 0.7 under it. The art median is 6.5 and the craft floor stood down at the cap. Frames 2, 3, 4 and 6 carried most of the art charge in every round. Two hard fails, both this run's own, were repaired. Frame 6 drew 4 stakes (40 MW) after a camera change, and was restored to 5. Frames 2 and 4 showed curly apostrophes from Manrope's contextual alternates, and the run first wrongly dismissed the judges on that, as no. 61 had. Fixed by turning calt off on those deks. Late repairs: frame 6's dek printed "10 MW", a drawing unit no claim carries, and was reworded. Its new visual review then found the longer dek running over a turbine rotor, so the rotor was turned and the grid line set farther off. It passed re-review with five stakes counted. That frame changed after the panel, so the score row reads STALE. The web edition printed five wrong numbers ("a 3 MW wind farm" and others) that every gate passed, found only by reading the page, and they were fixed. PROMPT AUDIT prompt audit: 2222 tool call(s) measured, 305 WAITED ON A HUMAN. The waits ran 1.0 to 28.1 seconds, about 12.0 minutes in all (Bash 260, Agent 42, SubagentHandback 2, Monitor 1). This session ran in auto mode, where a classifier decides each call, and waits of this size fit that classifier rather than a person. The log does not say which. One call was refused outright by that classifier, the browser agent measurement of faa.gov, and it was not retried. no-stall hook: armed at 2026-10-29T05:03:35Z at session start it judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), and the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED was 0. Every later call is judged again when it is made judged the session unattended from 2026-10-29T05:03:35Z (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0) refused nothing

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
